  "chunks": [
    {
      "chunk_type": "isnad",
      "arabic_text": "عَنْهُ عَنِ ابْنِْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ سَعْدَانَ عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ عَمَّارٍ قَالَ",
      "translations": {
        "en": "From him, from Ibn Mahboub, from Sa'dan, from Muawiya ibn 'Ammar, who said:"
      }
    },
    {
      "chunk_type": "body",
      "arabic_text": "قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) لَا تُمَانِعُوا قَرْضَ الْخَمِيرِ وَ الْخُبْزِ وَ اقْتِبَاسَ النَّارِ فَإِنَّهُ يَجْلِبُ الرِّزْقَ عَلَى أَهْلِ الْبَيْتِ مَعَ مَا فِيهِ مِنْ مَكَارِمِ الْأَخْلَاقِ",
      "translations": {
        "en": "Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: 'Do not prevent lending the yeast and the bread and the fire-lighter, for it brings sustenance upon the family, along with whatever is in it from the noble manners.'"
      }
    }
  ],
  "translations": {

      "seo_question": "What small acts of generosity attract sustenance according to Imam al-Sadiq?",
